item.description: In this talk from the 1980s, Ram Dass explores different forms of yoga—hatha, dhyan, jnana, bhakti, tantra, and more—and answers questions from the audience....

item.description: Chill to the beats on the Ram Dass 24/7 Lofi Radio. This 24/7 livestream is presented by Ram Dass’ Love Serve Remember Foundation.

item.title: Ram Dass – Here and Now – Ep. 295 – Across the Decades: Ram Dass On Expanding the Boundaries of Consciousness
item.description: Speaking across the decades from the 1960s through the 1990s, Ram Dass shares his thoughts on expanding the boundaries of consciousness through the use of psychedelic chemicals.

item.title: Ram Dass – Here and Now – Ep. 297 – Cultivating a Spiritual Perspective
item.description: Ram Dass explores how the process of karma yoga is about cultivating a spiritual perspective that allows us to see any situation on multiple planes simultaneously.

item.title: Ram Dass – Here and Now – Ep. 298 – The Web of Human Caring
item.description: Ram Dass explores living in times of great change, the cost of individuality to our compassionate hearts, and the importance of building and being part of the web of human caring.

item.title: The Last Act of Love: A Conversation with Mirabai Bush about What Ram Dass Taught Us Through His Death
item.description: Ram Dass wrote that dying is the most important thing you do in your life. He also wrote about learning to plan for your own death as a ‘spiritual ceremony’.
